messages:
ryan: Heads-up — found a boxed Dreamcast and thought of running a retro night next Tuesday? low-key, would bring my VGA box and Sonic Adventure. anyone want to bring adapters/controllers? :game_die:

emily: OMG yes. I have a VMU and an extra Dreamcast controller. can also bring a CRT monitor if ppl want full nostalgia.

jorge: I’ll bring my modded GC adapter so folks can use GameCube controllers (has turbo lol). also can run LAN via Steam Remote if someone brings a PC.

priya: count me in for classics. also quick poll: bring consoles only or make it console-agnostic? :thinking_face:

maria: i vote console-agnostic — keep room for newer folks. i can bring Switch + Mario Kart. also snacks: chips + fruit?

ryan: plan then: Dreamcast corner + Switch couch + PC booth. need power strips & extension cords. mezz outlets limited.

mezz-bot: Reminder: Mezzanine booking confirmed Tue 19:00-22:00. Event page: https://calendar.company/evt/2151234567

emily: protip: Dreamcast VGA requires 15kHz timing; CRT is safest. if anyone prefers HDMI, bring a framemeister or a cheap upscaler.

jorge: can someone bring ethernet? even if it's retro, we can stream a pooled playlist. i can curate an 80s-90s gaming soundtrack.

priya: i'll make a tiny form for sign-ups so we don't double up on consoles. who wants to do a quick 4-player Sonic speedrun bracket?

maria: maria - Switch + Mario Kart + chips

ryan: ryan - Dreamcast + VGA box + Sonic Adventure

emily: emily - Dreamcast controller + VMU + CRT

jorge: jorge - GC adapter + playlist + ethernet cable

priya: priya - signup form + bracket organizer

mezz-bot: Note: please label personal gear. Facilities asked us to clear the back table by 22:15.

ryan: sweet. see y'all Tuesday! :vintage_television: :sparkles:
